title: Doha, Qatar — October 5, 2026
text:
Doha, Qatar — October 5, 2026"

"🔆🔅Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni arrived in Doha on Monday evening for an official visit at the invitation of his Qatari counterpart, Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, as Qatar deepens its role as a diplomatic bridge between Tehran, Gulf states, and indirectly Washington."

"Momeni was received with an official ceremony by Abdulaziz bin Faisal, Qatar's Minister of State, upon his arrival at Doha airport. He is accompanied by a high-level delegation."

"Source: Iran's Interior Ministry
